title: Postgres Row-Level Security Tenant Context Injector
description: Inject tenant_id into Postgres connection session state to enforce row-level security isolation.
derived_requirements: Set local app.current_tenant_id in pooled connection transaction
Clear session setting on connection release to pool
Prevent tenant cross-talk during pooled connection reuse
Raise security exception if query executed without tenant context

required_behavior: Strict tenant isolation across parallel asynchronous queries
Reset session state before connection returns to pool
forbidden_behavior: Leaking Tenant A data to Tenant B under connection pooling

failure_taxonomy.description: Pooled connection retains prior tenant context leaking private data.

ground_truth_rationale: Multi-tenant architectures require absolute cryptographic & session boundary isolation.
